# wso2is_governance_connector (Resource)

Manages an identity governance connector. Governance connectors hold the tenant-wide login, registration, account recovery and account policies. In the Console, they are under **Login & Registration**.

The resource only manages the properties that you list. If you remove a property from the configuration, the provider sets it back to the server default. When you destroy the resource, the provider sets all listed properties back to their defaults, unless `restore_on_destroy = false`.

Examples of connectors are `account.lock.handler`, `account.disable.handler`, `self-sign-up`, `lite-user-sign-up`, `user-email-verification`, `account-recovery`, `admin-forced-password-reset`, `passwordHistory`, `passwordExpiry`, `multiattribute.login.handler`, `sso.login.recaptcha`, `suspension.notification`, `pii-controller`, `user-claim-update` and `organization-self-service`. MFA connectors include `email-otp-authenticator`, `sms-otp-authenticator`, `totp`, `backup-code-authenticator` and `FIDOAuthenticator`. To see a connector's properties, use the `wso2is_governance_connector` data source. To import, use the connector name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lock accounts after 5 failed attempts for 15 minutes.
resource "wso2is_governance_connector" "account_lock" {
  name = "account.lock.handler"
  properties = {
    "account.lock.handler.lock.on.max.failed.attempts.enable" = "true"
    "account.lock.handler.On.Failure.Max.Attempts"            = "5"
    "account.lock.handler.Time"                               = "15"
  }
}

# Allow self sign-up with email verification.
resource "wso2is_governance_connector" "self_sign_up" {
  name = "self-sign-up"
  properties = {
    "SelfRegistration.Enable"         = "true"
    "SelfRegistration.LockOnCreation" = "true"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Connector name, for example `account.lock.handler`.
- `properties` (Map of String) Property values by property name, for example `{ "account.lock.handler.lock.on.max.failed.attempts.enable" = "true" }`. Values are strings.

### Optional

- `restore_on_destroy` (Boolean) Revert the managed properties to the server defaults when the resource is destroyed. The default is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (String) Category the connector belongs to.
- `id` (String) Connector ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_governance_connector.account_lock account.lock.handler
```
